acceptance_criteria.criterion: getAll() returns both framework icons and the test custom icons.
getCustomIcons() returns exactly the test custom icons.
getStandardIcons() returns only framework icons (none of the custom test icons).
getByID('add')->createIcon() returns a UI_Icon with the correct type set.

summary: Created tests/AppFrameworkTests/UI/IconCollectionTest.php with 14 test methods covering all 7 acceptance criteria.

Tests verify: getAll() includes both standard and custom icons; getCustomIcons() returns exactly the 2 custom icons from the test fixture (planet, revisionable); getStandardIcons() returns no custom icons; getByID('planet').isCustom() is true; getByID('add').isStandard() is true; getByID('add').createIcon() returns a UI_Icon with type='plus-circle' and prefix='fa'; idExists('nonexistent') returns false.

All 14 tests pass (234 assertions) against the live test environment. The test fixture (tests/application/themes/custom-icons.json) with planet and revisionable icons was already in place from WP-001.

comments.note: The test custom-icons.json (tests/application/themes/custom-icons.json) has only two icons. A slightly wider fixture (3-4 custom icons) would make the getCustomIcons() count assertion more meaningful and less trivially satisfied. Not a blocker.

IconCollection uses a private static singleton with no reset mechanism, which makes it impossible to test edge cases like 'what if custom-icons.json is missing' without modifying the class. A protected static reset() method or an alternative factory taking explicit paths would help testability in future WPs.
No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent beyond the two notes above.

summary: IconCollectionTest reviewed — 14 tests covering all 7 acceptance criteria with 234 assertions. Test design is clean and idiomatic: final class, private constants for fixture IDs, section comments, static closures, and full coverage of both positive and negative paths including the RuntimeException case for unknown IDs. No Fix-Forward changes applied. All acceptance criteria confirmed met.

comments.note: Test structure is exemplary: final class, proper extends ApplicationTestCase, section comments dividing tests by method under test, private constants for fixture IDs instead of magic strings, assertion messages provided wherever a failure would be ambiguous.
Static closures correctly used in array_map callbacks — they don't capture $this so static is both correct and avoids any closure binding overhead.
test_getByID_createIcon_setsCorrectType() correctly asserts both type ('plus-circle') and prefix ('fa') on the returned UI_Icon. Good coverage depth for a single AC.
[documentation-forward] The collection() private helper method has no docblock. Although it is self-explanatory, a one-liner @return comment is conventional for test helper methods in this project.
The singleton-with-no-reset concern flagged by the Developer is a valid testability debt on the production class (IconCollection), not on this test file. No action needed here.
